messages.subject: Shiny bug with pictures?
parts:
FYI:

I have a Shiny code that produces a picture (on the main panel).
If I right-click on it, I can select from different options. For example "Save image as..." - and it works.
However, "Copy image" doesn't work. After you select "Copy image" and then try to paste it somewhere, there is nothing on the clipboard to paste...

Dimitri
